rationale.conceptual: The DFT method (PBE-D3/B3LYP-D3 + SMD) is a well-established, off-the-shelf protocol for computing adsorption energies. No novel theory or algorithmic derivation is needed; the difficulty lies in correctly applying the method to the specific fragment models.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves constructing three molecular models, running geometry optimizations and frequency calculations for three fragment cases plus a reference H₂, then extracting Gibbs free energies. This requires managing multiple input files, job dependencies, and post-processing, though each step is straightforward.
